verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a cloud storage service with a programmatic API. The evidence shows a Microsoft Graph API surface for OneDrive, but nothing documents permission scopes, least-privilege grants, app registration, or credential issuance for an agent. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
